# QE Strategy

Use qe-architect and test-strategy/risk-based-testing skills. Create a product-wide risk-based test strategy and per-service test approach. Include unit, component, integration, contract, E2E, visual, accessibility, security, performance, resilience, migration and recovery tests. Define test environments/data, CI gates, flake policy, automation priorities, ownership and phase exit criteria. Link the strategy to requirement/AC IDs. Do not claim tests passed. Request `APPROVE QE PLAN v1`.
